PUNJAB SKILLS DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY
RULES, 2022
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
8th June, 2023]
No.
5-8/ 2020(PSDA)(Rules), dated 5.6.2023.---In exercise of the powers conferred under section 26 of the Punjab
Skills Development Authority Act 2019 (VI of 2019), Governor of the Punjab is
pleased to make the following rules:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1)
These rules may be cited as the Punjab Skills Development Authority Rules,
2022.
(2) They
shall come into force at once.
2. Definitions.---(1) In the rules, unless the context or subject
requires otherwise:
(a) "Act"
means the Punjab Skills Development Authority Act, 2019 (VI of 2019);
(b) "rules"
means the Punjab Skills Development Authority Rules, 2022; and
(c) "Technical
education and Vocational Training" means training in any professional
skill, trade, calling or occupation.
(2) A
word or expression used but not defined in the rules shall have the same
meaning as assigned to it in the Act.
3. Regional
offices.---The Authority may, with
the prior approval of the Government, establish its regional offices and may
make any rearrangement as it deems fit for administrative efficacy and carrying
out its functions under the Act.
4. Appointment
of non-official members.---For
appointment of non-official members of the Authority under the Act, excluding
members of the Provincial Assembly, the Director General shall, through
Industries, Commerce, Investment and Skill Development Department of the
Government, recommend a panel of three persons against each vacancy from
industry, agriculture or services sectors and professionals from technical
education and vocational training sectors, for approval of the Government.
5. Allowances.---(1) The non-official member shall be entitled to
travelling or daily allowance and other related expenses incurred by him in the
performance of duties assigned to him by the Authority equivalent to an officer
of BS-20.
(2) The
Authority may determine the allowance of members of the Authority or
Committees, for participation in the meetings of the Authority or Committees,
as the case may be.
6. Acquisition
of property.---The Authority shall
have power to acquire and hold immovable property through purchase, lease,
donations and by transfer from any public or private source and shall manage
such immovable property by itself or, subject to approval of Government, by
outsourcing management of such immovable property to any public or private
organization without transferring the title under terms and conditions as
mutually agreed between the parties.
7. Meetings.---(1) A meeting of the Authority shall be held at
such time and place as the Chairperson may determine.
(2) The
Chairperson may call a meeting of the Authority, on need basis, in the interest
of the Authority or for disposal of a time limit business.
(3) The
Director General shall prepare agenda of the meeting regarding its business.
The agenda shall specify the facts, relevant data, analysis, recommendation or
proposal for decision of the Authority.
(4) The
Director General shall issue meeting notice along with agenda of the meeting at
least seven days before the meeting.
(5) The
Director General shall record minutes of the meeting, by specifying the main
relevant points of discussion, if any, and decisions on each agenda, and
circulate it amongst the members for communication of opinion or any correction
in the minutes within seven days of receipt of such minutes. If, no response is
received from a member, within the stipulated period, it shall be deemed to
have been consented or approved by such member.
(6) The
decision of the meeting, after approval by the Chairperson, shall be circulated
for implementation and progress shall be submitted to the Authority in its next
meeting.

and evaluation.---(1) The
